newsitem.title: UK: Allied sees 320 mln stg loss from C-T sale.
newsitem.headline: Allied sees 320 mln stg loss from C-T sale.

text.p: Allied Domecq Plc said on Sunday that it expected a loss on disposal of its stake in the Carslberg-Tetley venture of around 320 million stg.
It said the loss on disposal allowed for goodwill written back, pensions and other costs, and included provisions for eliminating the effects of the uneconomic beer supply agreement.
There would be a reduction in reserves after taxation of about 200 million stg.
Allied said Carlsberg-Tetley made trading profits of 25 million stg in the six months to end February 1996, an increase of 14 percent year on year.
"Our sale of Carlsberg-Tetley... is the culmination of a two year disposal programme of non-core businesses which will enable us to concentrate fully on the development of our spirits and
retailing businesses," said Allied's group chief executive Tony Hales in a statement.
